name: shine-border
title: Shine Border
description: A card's border lit by a soft multi-colour glow that slides slowly around it (one pass every 14 s).

moworks.author: magicui
moworks.call: MW.shineBorder(q(".mw-shine-border"), tl, 0, { borderWidth: 4, duration: 7, shineColor: ["#A07CFE", "#FE8FB5", "#FFBE7B"], hold: 7 });

credit.author: Magic UI (magicuidesign)
credit.madeNote: ported to GSAP on the film's clock; same timings, eases, sizes and colours; the original is linked

moworks.notes: Put .mw-shine-border inside the card (position: relative; border-radius inherited).
moworks.titleVi: Viền thẻ ánh màu trôi chậm
